RSCS Exported Functions

group RSCS_Exported_Functions

Functions

T_SERVER_ID rscs_add_service(void *p_func)

Add Running Speed and Cadence Service.

Example usage 

 void profile_init()
 {
      server_init(service_num);
      rscs_id = rscs_add_service(app_handle_profile_message);
}

参数:

p_func -- [in] Callback when service attribute was read/write.

返回值:

  • 0xFF -- Operation failure.

  • others -- Service ID assigned by Bluetooth Host.

返回:

Service ID T_SERVER_ID.

bool rscs_set_parameter(T_RSCS_PARAM_TYPE param_type, uint8_t len, void *p_value)

Set a Running Speed and Cadence Service parameter.

This function can be called with a RSCS parameter type T_RSCS_PARAM_TYPE and it will set the RSCS parameter. The 'p_value' field must point to an appropriate data type that meets the requirements for the corresponding parameter type. (For example, if required data length for parameter type is 1 octets, p_value should be cast to a pointer of uint8_t.)

Example usage 

void test(void)
{
    bool op_result = rscs_set_parameter(RSCS_PARAM_TOTALDISTANCE, 4, (uint8_t*)&total_distance);
}

参数:

  • param_type -- [in] Running Speed and Cadence Service parameter type: T_RSCS_PARAM_TYPE.

  • len -- [in] Length of data to write.

  • p_value -- [in] Pointer to data to write.

返回值:

  • true -- Operation success.

  • false -- Operation failure.

返回:

Operation result.

bool rscs_get_parameter(T_RSCS_PARAM_TYPE param_type, void *p_value)

Get a Running Speed and Cadence Service parameter.

This function can be called with a Running Speed and Cadence Service parameter type and it will get the parameter. Running Speed and Cadence Service parameters are defined in T_RSCS_PARAM_TYPE.

Example usage 

void test(void)
{
    bool ret = rscs_get_parameter(RSCS_PARAM_INC_FLAG, &bFlag);
}

参数:

  • param_type -- [in] Running Speed and Cadence Service parameter type: T_RSCS_PARAM_TYPE

  • p_value -- [inout] Pointer to data to read.

返回值:

  • true -- Operation success.

  • false -- Operation failure.

返回:

Operation result.

bool rscs_meas_value_notify(uint8_t conn_id, T_SERVER_ID service_id)

Send Running Speed and Cadence Service value notification data. Applications shall call rscs_set_parameter with param_type RSCS_PARAM_INC_FLAG to set value first, and then call this API to send the notification value.

Example usage 

void test(void)
{
    bool op_result = rscs_meas_value_notify(conn_id, rscs_id);
}

参数:

  • conn_id -- [in] Connection ID.

  • service_id -- [in] Service ID.

返回值:

  • true -- Operation success.

  • false -- Operation failure.

返回:

Operation result.

void rscs_calib_resutl_indicate(uint8_t conn_id, T_SERVER_ID service_id, bool result)

Send Running Speed and Cadence Service value indication data, send indication of result of calibration to client.

Example usage 

void test(void)
{
    rscs_calib_resutl_indicate(conn_id, rscs_id, result);
}

参数:

  • conn_id -- [in] Connection ID.

  • service_id -- [in] Service ID.

  • result -- [in] calibration result.
